notes.title: NEW BEATBUDDY GAME, BUNDLES & SOUNDTRACK!
notes.content:
[h1] Hey Beatbuddies[/h1]

To celebrate the release of the all new [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/412970/]Beatbuddy: On Tour[/url]
we've finally released the original Beatbuddy: Tale of the Guardians [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/257310/]Soundtrack on Steam![/url]
If you want to go ALL IN you can check out the new [url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/87158/]ULTIMATE BUNDLE[/url]
containing [b]both Beatbuddy Games, 2 Soundtracks and 3 playable prototypes[/b] evolved during the crazy development ride which started back in 2009. Get the tour started and let us know what you think about Beatbuddy's new gig.

We wish you a merry Christmas and thank everyone for all the great support!
[b]The Threaks[/b]

notes.title: Epic Patch with all new Mouse controls
notes.content:
The new Beatbuddy patch is here!

As a highlight we bring you brand new mouse controls. We completely refurbished the input and are super happy with the results! We also added a new menu song and made major improvements on the performance of the game, it should now run way smoother also on lower end machines. Of course we also fixed a lot of small and not so small Bugs.
This is what we call a patch! Hope you like it :)

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
We just released the second patch which includes the following:

- fixed more "level not visible" bugs
- fixed some tutorial messages not being displayed
- fixed a few more issues with the falling stones in Ruins
- fixed soldier spikes clipping through pipes
- fixed extras being cut off
- fixed some fixed snareplugs behaving strange
- fix for being able to open/close the pause menu too fast, stopping everything
- fixed keyboard warning not being shown long enough when starting new game
- fixed mouse indicator object behaving strange when player gets rotated
- made a lot of improvements to reduce lag/freezing
- a lot of bugfixes too small to list here

- fix Soundsources respawning although they were already used
- fix for Spikes not killing player sometimes
- fix Intro/Outro Video cut off
- made some improvements to reduce lag/freezing throughout the game, especially when reaching checkpoints

notes.title: Wot I Think: Beatbuddy: Tale Of The Guardians
notes.content:
One might think, as inclined as I might be to mix the scrutiny of game design with affectionately-intended trash pop, that Beatbuddy: Tale Of The Guardians is the crux of musicality, ingenuity and design I’d write scads of lovelorn poetry for.

Not only is each level of the underwater puzzler Beatbuddy: Tale Of The Guardians named a ‘song’ and comes with a different piece of music composed by such melodic adonises as Sabrepulse and Austin Wintory, but everything in this game has a beat, the artifacts of gameplay each add a small note to an eventual symphony of rhythm and beat and song. Your very collision with other sea creatures creates music and warps environment; enemies alert you to their presence off-screen by their music slowly working in on a tide towards you. But there’s something stuck in the heart of this grand piano. There’s something slightly out of shape. There’s something off. And that hurts: because that first glorious hour is like being bedded by some baritone merman with rigorous, human-proficient hands. You feel like you are an instrument being strummed. And you settle into the rhythm of it. (more…)

notes.title: Now Available - Beatbuddy: Tale of the Guardians
notes.content:
Beatbuddy: Tale of the Guardians is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

Awakened from his slumber, Beatbuddy journeys through lush hand-painted environments on a quest to save his companions and his own immortality. Beatbuddy interacts with the living breathing environment that pulses to the beat of an original soundtrack, aiding him as he unlocks new paths and solves puzzles.

KEY FEATURES

- Experience an action-adventure game in a whole new way, which incorporates music into every aspect of the beautiful world. Players interact with the environment and a variety of creatures to open paths and solve puzzles throughout their journey.
- Six beautifully hand painted levels, each broken into five chapters, take the player through the unique locations and vivid color pallets.
- Featuring an exclusively produced soundtrack with original songs composed specifically for the game by known artists including Austin Wintory, Parov Stelar, Sabrepulse and La Rochelle Band.
- Play as Beatbuddy, an ethereal creature who travels to unite with his sisters Melody and Harmony and stop the evil Prince Maestro with the aid of Clef who provides comic relief throughout their journey.

*offer ends August 13th at 10AM Pacific Time
